messages:
Elena: quick FYI  i'm drafting the changelog entry for the docs push. items: adaptive routing launch, console rollout UX copy, embed-streaming deprecation callout. Need: l10n keys extracted, snippet parity (py/ts/go/rust), and a short migration checklist for pinned variants.
Marcus: i'll do a snippet sweep across py/ts/go. drop the PR link?
Elena: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4955 branch `release/docs-changelog-sync`
Ibrahim: noted embed-streaming deprecation still referenced on a few embed pages. propose adding a "what to do" snippet and cross-link to the deprecation doc. also flagging that a few callouts use colloquial phrasing that will be hard to translate.
Yuna: i'll extract translation keys and simplify copy for bullets. will add keys as a follow-up commit in the PR. prefer short, neutral strings.
Marcus: python snippet fix: fallback_policy requires an object not a string  updating sample to:

client.generate(model="rwd-kestrel", input="hello", fallback_policy={"type": "model_variant", "priority": ["low_cost", "low_latency"]})

Ibrahim: migration checklist (short): 1) Pin replacement variant in model catalog; 2) Validate routing behavior in staging; 3) Monitor p99 + error rate for 24h. keep it terse for the migration guide.
docs-ci-bot: Staging preview built for PR #4955. Snippet rendering: OK. Anchor check: warnings for 2 redirected anchors.
Elena: please sweep raw anchors and absolute github raw URLs  switch to docs permalinks and include `/en/` default locale where applicable.
Marcus: swapped raw links to permalinks and fixed two anchors. pushed commit. :shipit:
Yuna: l10n note: avoid idioms in changelog bullets (e.g., "heads-up")  use neutral phrasing. i've added simplified texts to the PR. :globe_with_meridians:
Ibrahim: QA plan: i'll run py + ts samples against staging runtime tomorrow, collect token counts and latencies, then comment with numbers.
Elena: merge target EOD Friday. please add approvals in the PR once QA + l10n pass. i'll post the /product announcement after publish.
Marcus: approved after QA.
Yuna: approved (l10n keys extracted).
Elena: merging once CI green  thanks team! :tada:
